question: In exactly three deployed-cover gadget assets, is there a typed durability or damage-zone value that could be shown for a cover gadget, and how does its gadget Ability select that deployed object?
inference: The source supports reporting that the DamageZones asset contains serialized float32 fields and that the deployed-cover asset references both DamageZones and a shared Vehicle_Health channel. It does not identify a defensible cover-HP or damage-resistance field, unit, or effective runtime value. The Ability child references do not establish the selected deployed-object join within this bounded trace.
unresolved: Semantic names, roles, and units for the 50 float32 fields in VEH_Gadget_DeployedCover_DamageZones.
Whether any candidate float32 field means effective durability, per-zone damage, or another quantity; serialized values do not establish runtime activation or composition.
Exact link from DeployableCover_Ability through its imported child data to VEH_Gadget_DeployedCover; the direct Ability imports and one-hop children do not provide a source-proven selection join.
No site gadget table exists to compare a conditional presentation value.
siteImpact: No Analyzer gadget table exists. The 50 verified damage-zone floats have no selected Ability path, semantic roles or units, so no cover HP or resistance value is proposed.
